content: Nainugi-arbamaladgi burbar sunmaklesad
Jesús sogdebalid: “Ar Bab-Dummad-e-negdakmaid weyobdo: Dule-wargwen neg-neguya-sediid, wakudar neggi nodgua, e-nainugi-ega-arbamalaga dule-ega-arbamalad aminaded.
Dule-nainu-ibed arbamalad-ebo igar nabosad. Arbamaladga sogsad, ibagwena denario-gwagwen an be-bennukoye. Geb agi ega arbaega e-nainuse barmissunnad.
”Dad-abar-dummad-gusgu, gannar nainu-ibed, nodbalid. Geb dakdapid, ibmar-ukleged-naba dulemar arbaedsuli binsa bukwa dakdapid.
Agi nainu-ibed amarga sogded: ‘Ar bemar an-nainuse arbanamarmodo, ar sogedba an be-bennukmaloed.’ Amala, arbaegala, nade gusmalad.
”Yorukugusgua, nainu-ibed dulemar-amiega gannar nodbalid. Dulemar-amisgu, ega arbamalaga e-nainuse barmisbalid. Wachi-ilapaagi, amba deyob imaksabalid, degine amarga baiganga-sogsayob sogsabalid.
Wachi-ilatargi, nainu-ibed gannar nodbalid. Dulemar binsa bukwa dakdapbalid. Amarga sogded: ‘¿Ar ibiga bemar arbasuli emi be osedosmala?’
”Abin-imakdemalad: ‘Ar dule anmarga arbaed uksurmalad.’ Nainu-ibed amarga sogded: ‘Bemar an-nainuse arbanamarmoga, ar sogedba an bemar-bennukmaloed.’

”Neg-mutikgudgu, nainu-ibed ega-neg-dakedga sogded: ‘Arbamaladse be gole, ibagwen-arbasad-wilub be bennuk. Napisolaba-modapmalad-inse be bennuko. Geb degi, wakudarad-akar-arbananaid napisolaba be bennuko.’
”Napisolaba-arbasmalad nonimargu, denario-gwagwen bennuklesmalad.
Wakudar-yalaba-arbadmalad nonimarmogu, binsasmalad, emardi bur melu bennuklegoergebye. Ar amar bennuklearmargu, amba denario-gwagwen bennuklesmarmogad.
”Wakudar-yalaba-arbasmalad bennuklesmargu, nainu-ibedgi uluarmalad,
sogdemalad: ‘Wemar-sorba-nonimalad, unnila wachi-irgwen wis arbasmalad. Anmardi bur dummad-arbasad, dadba dummad-galitosad, degite, anmar-sunnaa bennuklesmarmogad.’
”Nainu-ibed, amar-wargwen-abinsadgu, sogded: ‘An-ai, an gwen begi dodossulid. ¿Ar bemarbo igar an nabossursi, denario-gwagwen an be-bennukoye?
Degisoggu, be-mani be sue, ar begadid. Be nae. Ar wemar-napisolaba-nonimalad bemar-sunnaa an bennukbiele, an-itolegeddo.
An-itolegedba an-mani an imakbier, ar wede akarsi. An dule-nued-daedba, ¿ar be angi nobsi?’
”Ar bukidar emar-idudimaladi, emar-sorbalidga gumaloed. Bukidar emar-sorbarmaladdi, emar-idumaladga gumaloed. [Ar ade, bukidar dulemarse gorleged, degite, unnila wis ichee dulemar sulegoed.]”
Jesús ilapaagus na e-burgoedgi sunmaksad
Jerusalénʼse nadapmargu, Jesús na e-sapingan-ambe-gakabogwadse (12) bachikii gochad. Amarga sogded:
“Emi anmar Jerusalénʼse nadapid. Ani Dule-Machi, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-e-dummaganga, degi, Garda-Narmaked-Dulemarga an uklegoed. Amar anga igar-itosmalar, sogmaloed, oburgwemarye.
Wemar-Judío-dummagan, Judíoʼsurmaladga an-ukmaloed, adi, angi dodomalagar, an-bibyomalagar, degi, nakrusgi an-biokmalagar. Ar degi-inigwele, ibapaagi gannar an durguoed.”
Jacobo, Juan-ebo dummadga gubigusmalad
Geb degi, Zebedeo-machimala-e-nan, Jesúsʼse e-machimalamala nonikid. Yokorgi sindigar abin signonigu, Jesúsʼse ibmar egisnonikid.

Jesús ega sogded: —¿Ibu be abege? Ome, abin-sogded: —Be negdakmai-gusale, we an-masmala-warbogwad dummaganga be nugsao. Gwensak be-argan-nuedsik-siged be imako. Baid be-argan-sapiledsik-siged be imakbalo.

Jesús sogded: —Ibmar be egisnanaid, be wissurmalad ibu be egisnanai. ¿Ar sunna be, an-nue-dummad-wilegoedyobi, be wilemarmogosi? Degine, ¿ar sunna be, an-dii-oglesadgi be oglemarmogosi? Jesús-abin sogdemalad: —Anmar sunna imakmala.
Jesús abin-sogded: —Be nabir sogmalad, ar be deyob gumarmogoed. Degi-inigwele, ar dummaganga-nug-imakeddi, adi, angi sisulid. Unnila an-Babgi siid. Bato an-Bab we-ganmargi-sigmaloed nug-imaksad.
Jesús-e-sapingan-e-ambedi (10) wemar-warbogwad-dummaganga-gubimalad itosmalad. Degisoggu, wemar gwenad-warbogwadgi uludmarsunnad.

Geb degi, Jesús e-sapinganse goted. Ega sogded: “Be nue wismalad, we-napneggi dulemar-dummaganga-gudimaladi e-sordamarba bur dule-dummad na san-imakdamalad. Degine, bela ega ibmar imakbi abedamalad. Deginbali, e-dulamala geg yogasaar ibmar imakdamalad, ar e-dummagan sabsur-gandikidba ega negsemaidaed.
”Bemardi mer deyob gumalo. Ar be dummadga-gubiele, maiyob be daergebed. Bela be dulemar-bendakergebed.
Ar be dulemar-iduedga-gubiele, bela be dulemar-maiga be guergebed.
”Ar ani Dule-Machi, we-napnegse an nonikidi, mai-nikuega an nonisulid. Maiyob dulemar-bendakega an nonikid, degi, an na-san-burba-ukega an nonikid, degine, dule-isgudimalad-anar-burgwega an nonikid.”
Jesús, ibyasurmalad-warbo nudaksad
Jesús e-sapinganmala Jericó-neggweburgi-noarmargu, dulemar-bukidar eba armalad.
Deun, ibyasurmalad-warbo, igar-dikarba-simalad. Amar, Jesús-nadapye-itosmargu, binnasur Jesúsʼse gotemalad, sogdemalad: —¡Dummad, Rey-David-wagwa! ¡Anmar-bendake, wile be anmar-dake!
Boo sigmalaga, dulemar ese uluarmalad. Aka bur bule dule-ibyasurmalad binnasur Jesúsʼse gotemalad, sogdemalad: —¡Dummad, Rey-David-wagwa! ¡Wile be anmar-dake!
Jesús, ibyasurmalad-itosgu, gwisgusad. Amarse goted. Ega sogded: —¿Ibu bemarga imakbi be an-abemarsunna?
Dule-ibyasurmalad sogdemalad: —Dummad, mag-atake be anmar-imake.
Geb Jesús amar-wile-dakdegusad. Wiledakedba, amar-ibya-ebus imaksad. Agi ega ibya yog-nuguar nadmalad. Wemar-warbo-ibya-nugusad Jesúsʼba nadegusmalad.
